hazard_consequence_node.label: HazardConsequence
hazard_consequence_node.name: Pool fire
hazard_consequence_node.evidence: The report states, "This case study examines a fire at the Environmental Quality Company (EQ) hazardous waste facility in Apex, North Carolina." It further says, "Within minutes, the fire spread to the flammable liquid storage area, causing 55-gallon drums of flammable hazardous waste to explode and sending fireballs hundreds of feet into the air."
hazard_consequence_node.explanation: The incident is analyzed primarily as a large uncontrolled fire involving stored flammable liquid hazardous wastes. The report's main discussion centers on fire detection, fire control equipment, and lack of fire barriers that allowed the fire to spread. Drum explosions/fireballs and the toxic smoke cloud are treated as escalation effects and consequences of the main fire. Among the available labels, "Pool fire" is the closest match to the sustained flammable-liquid fire that drove the incident.

entity_nodes.label: Material
entity_nodes.name: flammable hazardous waste
entity_nodes.explanation: Flammable hazardous waste was the principal fuel involved in the major fire after the incident spread into the flammable liquid storage area.

condition_nodes.label: Phase
condition_nodes.name: Liquid
condition_nodes.explanation: The principal burning material was stored in an area designated for flammable liquids, indicating a liquid-phase fuel for the main fire.

condition_nodes.label: Combustibility
condition_nodes.name: Combustible
condition_nodes.explanation: The material is explicitly described as flammable, so it was capable of burning and sustaining the fire.

event_nodes.label: InitiatingEvent
event_nodes.name: small fire in the oxidizer bay
event_nodes.evidence: The initial “sofa-size” fire observed by firefighters was in the oxidizer bay
event_nodes.explanation: The earliest identified abnormal event was a small fire in the oxidizer bay, which then spread to the adjacent flammable-liquid storage area.

event_nodes.label: IgnitionSource
event_nodes.name: Unknown ignition source
event_nodes.explanation: The report clearly indicates ignition had occurred, but it does not identify the specific source that ignited the initial materials.
